message.projecthero.undead.acquired_hint: Every part of you breaks and regrows: a lost part starts growing back after a second and a half. Tap V to force your body back together, hold V to tear off an arm as a bone sword.
projecthero.guide.undead.regen.body: Your body is ten segments: head, body, both arms and both legs (down to the wrist and ankle), both hands and both feet. A lost segment waits a second and a half, then grows back in about a second (head 0.85s, body 1s, arm 0.9s, leg 1s, hand 0.6s, foot 0.55s): first bone, then raw muscle, then your skin coming back over it pixel by pixel, with a soft hiss. They grow in order, like a real body: nothing starts before what it grows from has grown out to it, so a hand only starts once its arm's bone has reached the wrist, a foot once its leg's has reached the ankle, the legs once the body's has reached the hips, the arms once the body is past the shoulders and the body once the head has started. Regrowth is always on and free: no hunger. Your health comes back on its own, half a heart every quarter of a second, even mid-fight. A hand you don't have holds nothing: the item stays in its slot but can't be used or swung until the hand is back. A part that comes off without being thrown stays standing where it was for a moment, falls over and crumbles away. Tap V to Reform: every missing or regrowing part whole on the spot, 3 hearts healed and fire, poison and wither gone (20 second cooldown).
projecthero.guide.undead.commands.body: /projecthero power grant undead [player]. /projecthero power tune undead break <head|body|right_arm|left_arm|right_leg|left_leg|all>, restore.
projecthero.undead.ability.reform.desc: Tap V: force your body back together at once. Every part that is gone or still regrowing is whole on the spot, you heal 3 hearts, and fire, poison, wither and every other harmful effect on you go. Free. Not while the Bone Sword is out (V puts it away). 20s cooldown.
